name: Environment protection licences and approvals
what: Hold an environment protection licence for scheduled activities (such as mining, manufacturing, waste and intensive farming) and get Commonwealth approval where a project may affect matters of national environmental significance.

basis.quote: Where construction work could harm protected plants, animals, habitats or places, businesses must follow the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999 .

basis.source: Performance Benchmarking of Australian Business Regulation: Planning, Zoning and Development Assessments (volume 1)
basis.quote: Impact of Commonwealth environmental requirements Under the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999 (Cwlth) (EPBC Act)

issues.what: Developers report long, shifting requests for information in Commonwealth environmental assessments.

evidence.source: Investing in cheaper, cleaner energy and the net zero transformation: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: Developers report that the EPBC assessment process is overly stringent, with complex and duplicative requests for additional information and shifting requirements

issues.status_note: The PC reported in 2025 that recent reforms to national environment laws aim to speed up approvals; their effect is not yet known.
